hermes_risk_feed.summary: Global equity markets rallied and volatility plunged despite the Federal Reserve approving its first interest rate hike in three years to combat inflation. However, the US 10-year Treasury yield remaining near 4.95% poses severe monetary tightening headwinds for risk assets.
